character.name: Idle
character.prompt: An electronics store horror enemy for a 1990s American shopping mall horror roguelite. A humanoid built around a CRT television: where the head should be sits a large CRT in a beige plastic case with a cracked dark screen and a faint glow, mounted forward of the shoulders so the figure is TOP-HEAVY and bent under the weight. It wears the remnants of a 1990s electronics-store uniform - a burgundy polo shirt with a small blank badge containing NO lettering, and dark trousers - now split and stretched around the mass. VCR guts, coiled cable and flat ribbon wire spill from the chest and hang toward the ground, tangled with cassette mechanisms and a small speaker cone. One arm is a bundle of cable ending in a plug; the other is a normal arm gone grey. POSTURE: bent sharply forward at the waist with the head-mass jutting ahead of the feet and the arms hanging, so the silhouette leans forward and is much heaviest at the top. CRITICAL: the beige CRT case, the burgundy polo and the VCR and cable parts keep the electronics retail object recognisable. STYLE: detailed late-SNES pixel art, crisp hard pixels, clean deliberate clusters, selective outlines, minimal dithering, no anti-aliasing, no blur. LIGHTING: neutral overhead fluorescent mall lighting with the screen glowing faintly. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.
